# Amy Removed Forms

All statement forms listed here have been removed from the Amy language surface.
Each entry was once accepted and now produces a hard compiler error pointing to
the canonical replacement. Use the canonical form in all new code.


## Arithmetic statements

| Removed form | Canonical replacement |
|---|---|
| `add X by N` | `X += N` |
| `add N to X` | `X += N` |
| `sub X by N` | `X -= N` |
| `subtract N from X` | `X -= N` |
| `multiply/mul X by N` | `X *= N` |
| `divide/div X by N` | `X /= N` |
| `min/max X with/to Y` | `X = min/max(X, Y)` |


## Shift statements

| Removed form | Canonical replacement |
|---|---|
| `shl/shift left X` | `X <<= 1` |
| `shr/shift right X` | `X >>= 1` |
| `shl/shift left X by N` | `X <<= N` |
| `shr/shift right X by N` | `X >>= N` |


## Declaration prefixes and aliases

| Removed form | Canonical replacement |
|---|---|
| `dim/ram/local Type ...` | `Type ...` |
| `boolean Type usage` | `bool` |
| `bcd N Name (byte-count form, no 'digits' keyword)` | `bcd digits (N*2) Name` |


## Array bulk operations

| Removed form | Canonical replacement |
|---|---|
| `copy array Dst from Src [count N]` | `copy Src [count N] to Dst` |


## Legacy u32 operation verbs

| Removed form | Canonical replacement |
|---|---|
| `u32 zero X` | `clear X` |
| `u32 copy A to B` | `B = A` |
| `u32 add A to B` | `B += A` |
| `u32 inc X` | `inc X` |
| `u32 sub A from B` | `B -= A` |

| `abs V into X` | `X = abs(V)` |

| `exp V into X` | `X = exp(V)` |
